title: Chatham Bites and Sights Walking Guided Food Tasting Tour
includes: Walking tour of historic Chatham covering 1 mile
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Maximum number of passengers per tour is 12
Children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by an adult. (Infants ages 4 and under who are not eating do not require a ticket)
Tour is held in all weather conditions (ponchos provided in case of rain)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Taste your way through the heart of Cape Cod on a relaxed, flavor-packed food tour through Chatham’s most iconic streets and hidden gems. Led by a local expert, this 3-hour walking tour features multiple tasting stops with hand-picked seasonal bites from beloved local spots. It’s a delicious way to explore the area, whether it’s your first visit or your summer tradition.

Along the way, hear the stories behind the food—tales of tradition, local legends, and the people who make Chatham so special.
